metadata.description: Parallel threads: Invoice analysis (A) vs Event patterns (B)

turns.content: I want to explore two areas. First, invoice payment patterns. Second, user event activity. Let's start with invoices.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge both threads and start with invoices

turns.content: Show me invoice payment status distribution for 2024.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show invoice status breakdown

turns.content: For invoices, only include those with amount > $100.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to invoices > $100

turns.content: Thread B — show me event types by volume.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show event counts by type

turns.content: For events, only count events from active users (logged in within 90 days).

annotations.establishesFilter: Active users = logged in within 90 days
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 90-day activity window

turns.content: Thread A — what's the average time to payment?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate payment timing

turns.content: Use invoice.due_date for payment timing analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use due_date for timing

turns.content: Thread B — which events correlate with retention?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze event types vs retention

turns.content: Is there a correlation? Do accounts with failed invoices have different event patterns?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should cross-reference both threads

turns.content: Thread A — show me failed invoices by account tier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show failed invoices by tier

turns.content: Thread B — show me event patterns by user role.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze events by role

turns.content: Exclude internal test accounts from both threads.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out test accounts

turns.content: Apply the same invoice filter to show me overdue invoices.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use amount > $100 filter

turns.content: Thread A — what industries have the most payment failures?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show failed invoices by industry

turns.content: Thread B — what events do churned users perform before leaving?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze pre-churn events

turns.content: Earlier in Thread A we looked at payment timing. What was the average?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall payment timing

turns.content: Thread B — do users with more events have better payment behavior?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate events with payment status

turns.content: Both threads — identify accounts with both failed invoices and declining events.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should find intersection of both threads

turns.content: Thread A — show me invoice amount distribution.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show invoice amount distribution

turns.content: Apply the same event filter to show me events by industry.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use 90-day activity filter

turns.content: Thread B — what was the active user definition we used?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall 90-day activity definition

turns.content: Thread A — do larger invoices take longer to pay?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate invoice size with payment time

turns.content: What filters are active for thread A?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: amount > $100, due_date, exclude test

turns.content: What filters are active for thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: 90-day activity, exclude test

turns.content: Create a chart showing invoice status distribution (Thread A).

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create invoice visualization

turns.content: Create a chart showing events by type (Thread B).

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create event visualization

turns.content: Thread A — show me top accounts by failed invoice value.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should rank accounts by failed invoice total

turns.content: Thread B — show me event trends over time.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show event volume trends

turns.content: Apply all filters for a combined analysis.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply all thread filters

turns.content: Create a combined dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create combined dashboard

turns.content: Final synthesis — summarize invoice and event findings.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should synthesize both threads

turns.content: What are the top 5 recommendations?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide recommendations

turns.content: Create a final summary dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create final dashboard

turns.content: Thank you. We've identified that accounts with declining event activity are 3x more likely to have failed invoices, and Healthcare industry has both the highest payment failure rate and lowest event engagement.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings
